scope: Read-only installed PEFT0.19.1 source; no model construction, training or new GPU run.
feasible_design: Create one239-target LoRA adapter over238 canonical text modules plus exact lm_head. Preserve text rank32/alpha64 and use rank_pattern/alpha_pattern for independently fixed head rank.
Load all476 CE64 parent text factors with exact FP32 byte equality. Only two missing head factors permitted; randomA/zeroB yields identity at initialization.
Freeze all pre-existing text factors and base parameters; optimize only lm_head A/B. Base tied input/output weight stays shared and frozen; additive LoRA affects only output invocation.

Serialize one combined478-factor adapter with save_embedding_layers=False. Reload on pinned clean base, verify all476 parent factors unchanged, two head factors exact and ordinary inference equivalence.

critical_source_evidence.rank_pattern: LoraModel._create_and_replace resolves rank_pattern and alpha_pattern via get_pattern_key against current_key.
critical_source_evidence.output_only: Linear.forward computes base_layer(x) + lora_B(lora_A(dropout(x)))*scaling, then casts back to original output dtype.
critical_source_evidence.save_auto_pitfall: get_peft_model_state_dict defaults save_embedding_layers=auto; lm_head is an embedding-layer target and can enable full embedding/head saving. ExplicitFalse required to keep adapter-only478 tensors.
critical_source_evidence.merge_pitfall: Linear.merge mutates base_layer.weight.data; tied input weight can therefore change. Do not merge while tied; a future standalone native publisher must explicitly untie output and validate input identity.

qualification_gates: Two trainable FP32 tensors only; exact478 serialized LoRA factors and239 intended modules, no vision/embedding/base-weight save.
Native zeroB initial full logits equal CE64, frozen476 factors and input embedding bytes unchanged after optimization.
Combined-adapter fresh reload exact factors/logits within explicitly frozen runtime tolerance; output-only tying assertion before/after.
Model-specific logits softcapping/scaling must remain exact if caching hidden states to avoid repeated frozen forward.
mechanism_limits: This freezes existing hidden representations rather than erasing their knowledge. It is an output behavior/selectivity experiment; no concept-deletion guarantee.
An output-head update can still restore occupational answers or create unrelated false refusals because hidden states and output tokens overlap.
Only64 ordinary authored paths may overfit; training endpoint fit cannot replace full raw behavioral evaluation.
PEFT source behavior is established; actual Gemma3 combined-adapter integration has not yet been qualified.
efficiency: Frozen upstream weights remove their optimizer state and backward graph. Exact cached final hidden states are potentially reusable, but any cache requires separate source/boundary validation and is not approved here.
